mcp_tokens_secret_ck.name: mcp_tokens_secret_ck
mcp_tokens_secret_ck.value: ("mcp_tokens"."kind" = 'pat' and "mcp_tokens"."token_hash" is not null and "mcp_tokens"."oauth_grant_id" is null) or ("mcp_tokens"."kind" = 'oauth' and "mcp_tokens"."oauth_grant_id" is not null and "mcp_tokens"."token_hash" is null and "mcp_tokens"."token_hint" is null)

contact_policies_state_ck.name: contact_policies_state_ck
contact_policies_state_ck.value:
(
        ("contact_policies"."do_not_contact" and "contact_policies"."source" is not null and "contact_policies"."set_at" is not null and "contact_policies"."cleared_at" is null)
        or (not "contact_policies"."do_not_contact" and "contact_policies"."source" is not null and "contact_policies"."set_at" is not null and "contact_policies"."cleared_at" is not null and "contact_policies"."cleared_at" >= "contact_policies"."set_at")
        or (not "contact_policies"."do_not_contact" and "contact_policies"."source" is null and "contact_policies"."set_at" is null and "contact_policies"."cleared_at" is null)
      )

people_creation_key_ck.name: people_creation_key_ck
people_creation_key_ck.value: "people"."creation_key" is null or char_length("people"."creation_key") between 8 and 200

sends_kind_shape_ck.name: sends_kind_shape_ck
sends_kind_shape_ck.value:
("sends"."kind" = 'campaign' and "sends"."enrollment_id" is not null and "sends"."step_number" is not null)
        or ("sends"."kind" = 'test' and "sends"."enrollment_id" is null and "sends"."step_number" is null and "sends"."channel" = 'email'
            and "sends"."mailbox_id" is not null and "sends"."to_address" is not null)

ai_jobs_lock_ck.name: ai_jobs_lock_ck
ai_jobs_lock_ck.value: ("ai_jobs"."status" = 'running') = ("ai_jobs"."locked_at" is not null and "ai_jobs"."locked_by" is not null and "ai_jobs"."started_at" is not null)

ai_jobs_completion_ck.name: ai_jobs_completion_ck
ai_jobs_completion_ck.value: "ai_jobs"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'skipped') or "ai_jobs"."completed_at" is not null

ai_jobs_failed_ck.name: ai_jobs_failed_ck
ai_jobs_failed_ck.value: "ai_jobs"."status" <> 'failed' or ("ai_jobs"."failed_at" is not null and length(btrim("ai_jobs"."last_error")) > 0)

conversations_reply_type_needs_group_ck.name: conversations_reply_type_needs_group_ck
conversations_reply_type_needs_group_ck.value: "conversations"."reply_type_id" is null or "conversations"."group_key" is not null

conversations_assigned_source_ck.name: conversations_assigned_source_ck
conversations_assigned_source_ck.value: ("conversations"."assigned_source" is null or "conversations"."assigned_source" in ('auto', 'human', 'cleared')) and ("conversations"."assigned_to" is null or "conversations"."assigned_source" is not null)

identity_exceptions_resolution_ck.name: identity_exceptions_resolution_ck
identity_exceptions_resolution_ck.value:
("identity_exceptions"."status" = 'open' and "identity_exceptions"."resolved_person_id" is null and "identity_exceptions"."resolved_at" is null)
        or ("identity_exceptions"."status" = 'resolved' and "identity_exceptions"."resolved_at" is not null)
        or ("identity_exceptions"."status" = 'ignored' and "identity_exceptions"."resolved_person_id" is null and "identity_exceptions"."resolved_at" is not null)

reply_type_picks_group_keys_ck.name: reply_type_picks_group_keys_ck
reply_type_picks_group_keys_ck.value:
("reply_type_picks"."previous_group_key" is null or "reply_type_picks"."previous_group_key" in ('customer', 'interested', 'not_interested', 'other'))
        and ("reply_type_picks"."proposed_group_key" is null or "reply_type_picks"."proposed_group_key" in ('customer', 'interested', 'not_interested', 'other'))
        and ("reply_type_picks"."applied_group_key" is null or "reply_type_picks"."applied_group_key" in ('customer', 'interested', 'not_interested', 'other'))

send_attempts_origin_ck.name: send_attempts_origin_ck
send_attempts_origin_ck.value: "send_attempts"."origin" in ('person', 'agent') and ("send_attempts"."origin" = 'agent' or ("send_attempts"."mcp_token_id" is null and "send_attempts"."client_name" is null))

send_attempts_refs_ck.name: send_attempts_refs_ck
send_attempts_refs_ck.value:
length(btrim("send_attempts"."idempotency_key")) > 0
        and ("send_attempts"."provider" is null or length(btrim("send_attempts"."provider")) > 0)
        and ("send_attempts"."account_ref" is null or length(btrim("send_attempts"."account_ref")) > 0)

mia_runs_fit_person_ck.name: mia_runs_fit_person_ck
mia_runs_fit_person_ck.value: ("mia_runs"."capability" = 'lead_fit') = ("mia_runs"."person_id" is not null and "mia_runs"."batch_id" is not null)

mia_threads_title_ck.name: mia_threads_title_ck
mia_threads_title_ck.value: "mia_threads"."title" is null or length("mia_threads"."title") between 1 and 200
